## About
We're a family owned and operated business, and we keep our focus narrow on purpose: alignment, suspension and brakes for all cars and trucks. That's the work we know best, and it's the work we do every day.
Neighbors tell us they like that we're straight with them. If your car doesn't need an alignment, we'll say so. If something else is causing the pull, we'll explain what we found.
You'll find us at 12639 N. Cave Creek Road in Phoenix, with a second shop in Glendale on W. Bethany Home Road. Give us a call and we'll get you on the schedule.

## Services
- Front wheel alignment and toe set: We adjust your suspension components to the proper angles so the car tracks straight and your tires wear evenly.
- Thrust alignment: The front wheels are aligned to the rear axle, so the direction the rear wheels push matches where the front is steering.
- Four wheel alignment with mechanical rear wheel adjustment: Often needed on all-wheel-drive models with independent suspensions.
- Brake parts and service: Call us to talk through brake parts and service for your car.
- Free alignment check and brake safety inspection: Not sure if something's off? Call and ask about a free alignment check and brake safety inspection.

## FAQ
Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call. Appointments are booked by phone only, though you're welcome to email general questions.

Q: Can you set an alignment to my own specs?
A: Yes. One customer who autocrosses had us set camber, caster and toe to their exact specifications.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes. Along with our Phoenix shop on N. Cave Creek Road, we have a location in Glendale on W. Bethany Home Road.
